status_definitions.description: The resolved value is supported by sufficient evidence for the declared subject and interval.
A required source channel, contract field, or provider capability is absent.
The required source exists, but the subject or condition cannot be observed in the interval.
Sufficient evidence exists, but it supports multiple unresolved interpretations.

source_definitions.description: Canonical map, selected route, map-match, and static traffic-rule evidence.
Metric ego pose, orientation, timestamp, and derived kinematic evidence.
Schema-constrained evidence from an OpenAI-compatible road-scene model.
Deterministic decoded-image, timing, exposure, blur, and artifact measurements.
Cross-source geometry, tracking, temporal state-machine, and conflict-resolution evidence.
Optional normalized vehicle-bus signals such as wheel speed, brake, steering, and gear.

backend_definitions.name: Deterministic cross-source fusion and state machine

labels.description: Functional character of the road surroundings.

allowed_values.description: Dense city environment with predominantly urban land use.
Lower-density developed environment outside a dense urban core.
Sparsely developed countryside or agricultural environment.
Controlled-access high-speed road environment.
Environment dominated by housing and local access.
Environment dominated by industrial or logistics land use.
Parking facility or parking-dominated circulation area.

acquisition.required_evidence: Land-use or road-context map attributes, or observable surround imagery.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use mapped functional context when explicit; otherwise classify visible built environment with ORV.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR is prohibited because geometry alone does not establish land use. Insufficient visible context is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Surround views and the current road neighborhood.
labels.hysteresis: Require two consecutive visual intervals before changing a VLM-only context.

labels.description: Current road hierarchy or use.

allowed_values.description: Controlled-access motorway.
Major trunk road below motorway classification.
Primary road in the provider hierarchy.
Secondary road in the provider hierarchy.
Tertiary road in the provider hierarchy.
Local road serving residential access.
Service or access road.
Connector ramp between road facilities.
Circulation aisle inside a parking facility.
Road space intentionally shared across participant types.

acquisition.required_evidence: A current map-matched lane or road with a provider road class.
acquisition.routing_policy: Apply the versioned provider-class to ontology mapping.
acquisition.fallback_policy: An unmapped but present class is ambiguous; missing or invalid map data is unavailable. Camera shape is not a fallback.

labels.spatial_context: Map-matched current road segment.
labels.hysteresis: Change only after the map match enters the next segment beyond the configured boundary margin.

labels.description: Whether opposing traffic is physically divided.

allowed_values.description: Opposing traffic is separated by a median, barrier, or carriageway gap.
Opposing traffic shares one undivided road platform.

acquisition.required_evidence: Opposing-direction topology and median or barrier primitives.
acquisition.routing_policy: Group opposing carriageways deterministically; use BMR only for irregular valid topology.
acquisition.fallback_policy: ORV visual evidence is experimental when map data is absent. Occluded road separation is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Current segment and 100 m route lookahead.
labels.hysteresis: Retain the segment value until the map match crosses a carriageway boundary.

labels.description: Permitted travel direction on the current road.

allowed_values.description: Traffic rules permit travel in one direction only.
Traffic rules permit opposing travel directions.

acquisition.required_evidence: Canonical traffic-rule direction or an explicit one-way map attribute.
acquisition.routing_policy: Read canonical traffic rules from the map-matched lane.
acquisition.fallback_policy: ORV requires visible one-way signs or arrows and remains experimental. Geometry without direction metadata is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Current connected lane.
labels.hysteresis: Change only on a stable map-match transition.

labels.description: Signed horizontal geometry of the ego-connected road.

allowed_values.description: Signed curvature remains within the configured deadband.
The connected road curves left in ego FLU coordinates.
The connected road curves right in ego FLU coordinates.

acquisition.required_evidence: A valid current or selected-route centerline.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute robust signed curvature over a versioned forward arc.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR is limited to fragmented but connected valid geometry. Invalid centerline is unavailable; competing curvature signs are ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: 30-80 m forward centerline arc.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate straight-entry and curve-exit curvature thresholds.

labels.description: Vertical profile of the driven road.

allowed_values.description: Smoothed road grade remains within the configured level deadband.
The driven road has sustained positive grade.
The driven road has sustained negative grade.
Grade transitions from positive toward negative at a local high point.
Grade transitions from negative toward positive at a local low point.

acquisition.required_evidence: Reliable map elevation or GNSS/INS altitude profile with pose quality.
acquisition.routing_policy: Estimate smoothed grade and grade derivative over a frozen baseline.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No reliable elevation is unavailable. BMR and ORV are prohibited from inferring precise grade.

labels.spatial_context: Driven road elevation profile.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate entry and exit thresholds for grade and grade derivative.

labels.description: Topology of the current or approaching junction.

allowed_values.description: No junction exists in the declared route-local spatial context.
Three-arm junction with a terminating branch.
Three-arm junction with a fork-like branch geometry.
Four-arm or cross-shaped at-grade junction.
Offset pair of closely spaced three-arm junctions.
Junction organized around a directed circulating roadway.
Two compatible traffic streams combine into one.
One traffic stream separates into multiple branches.
Crossing or interchange movement separated by road level.

acquisition.required_evidence: Lane-graph connectivity, intersection polygons, branch angles, cycles, and road levels.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify graph topology deterministically and invoke BMR only for irregular valid topology.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Missing graph is unavailable. Multiple classes remaining after cited-primitive validation are ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Current road and junctions reached within 100 m.
labels.hysteresis: Keep the selected junction identity until it is passed or the route changes.
labels.none_semantics: A valid map and route show no junction in the declared lookahead.

labels.description: Ego position relative to a route-relevant junction.

allowed_values.description: Ego is before and approaching the route-relevant junction.
Ego is inside the junction polygon or conflict area.
Ego has left the junction and remains in the configured exit zone.
Ego is outside approach, junction, and exit zones.

acquisition.required_evidence: Valid junction geometry, route distance, and ego map match.
acquisition.routing_policy: Apply a deterministic approach-inside-exit-midblock state machine.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Poor map match is ambiguous; absent map coverage is unavailable.

labels.spatial_context: Route-relevant junction and configured approach/exit buffers.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate polygon entry and exit buffers to prevent boundary oscillation.

labels.description: Control governing the route-relevant junction movement.

allowed_values.description: The movement is governed by a traffic signal.
The movement is governed by a stop sign.
The movement is governed by a yield sign.
Complete mapped coverage shows no explicit junction control.
A supported junction control exists outside the listed specific classes.

acquisition.required_evidence: Route-relevant regulatory elements and lane association.
acquisition.routing_policy: Associate mapped controls to the selected movement; use BMR only for ambiguous rendered association and ORV for corroboration.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A visible unassociated control is ambiguous. Uncontrolled requires complete valid coverage; missing coverage is unavailable.

labels.spatial_context: Route-relevant approach and control association.
labels.hysteresis: Retain control association while the same junction movement remains selected.

labels.description: Action planned by the selected route, independent of actual ego motion.

allowed_values.description: Continue along the current route lane without a decisive branch action.
Proceed straight through a route-relevant junction.
Take the selected left-turn route branch.
Take the selected right-turn route branch.
Reverse travel direction through the selected route movement.
Join another route-compatible traffic stream.
Leave the current stream onto a selected branch.
Enter the selected roundabout circulation.
Leave roundabout circulation at the selected exit.

acquisition.required_evidence: Selected route lane sequence, transition type, and signed heading change.
acquisition.routing_policy: Resolve the first decisive selected-route action within lookahead using graph and geometry rules.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR handles only irregular valid topology. Missing route is unavailable; route discontinuity is ambiguous. Actual ego trajectory is prohibited.

labels.spatial_context: Selected route up to 100 m ahead.
labels.hysteresis: Retain the action until the decisive transition is passed or the selected route changes.

labels.description: Lane count in the ego travel direction.

allowed_values.description: One travel lane exists in the ego direction.
Two parallel travel lanes exist in the ego direction.
Three parallel travel lanes exist in the ego direction.
Four or more parallel travel lanes exist in the ego direction.

acquisition.required_evidence: Parallel ego-direction lane group and travel-direction rules.
acquisition.routing_policy: Count stable travel-direction lanes over the current carriageway.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR may resolve complex valid split or merge geometry. Camera-only ORV is experimental; partial map coverage is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Current carriageway over a 50 m stable span.
labels.hysteresis: Change after the lane group remains stable across the configured span.

labels.description: Lane types present in the local road corridor.

allowed_values.description: General-purpose motor-vehicle lane.
Lane reserved or designated for buses.
Lane reserved or designated for bicycles.
Lane or track area designated for trams.
Lane reserved for emergency use.
Lane restricted to a specified turn movement.
Lane or strip designated for parking.
Lane explicitly shared by multiple participant classes.
No listed lane type is present in the completely observed corridor.

acquisition.required_evidence: Lane subtype or regulatory attributes and visible lane symbols.
acquisition.routing_policy: Map canonical lane attributes, detect visible markings, and union corroborated types.
acquisition.fallback_policy: None requires complete valid coverage. Missing attributes are unavailable; temporary map/visual conflict is ambiguous or workzone evidence.

labels.spatial_context: Current carriageway.
labels.hysteresis: Visual-only lane types require persistence across two observations unless mapped.
labels.none_semantics: The complete observed corridor contains none of the listed lane types.

labels.description: Visual condition of route-local lane markings.

allowed_values.description: Relevant lane markings are clearly visible and continuous.
Relevant markings are present but visibly worn or low contrast.
A marking expected from geometry or map evidence is visually absent.
Temporary markings alter or replace the normal lane guidance.
Relevant markings exist but cannot be seen because of occlusion.

acquisition.required_evidence: Visible road surface around relevant lane boundaries with valid exposure.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use ORV on front and front-side clips after image-quality observability gates.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Boundary outside view or invalid imagery is not_observable. Missing requires expected-boundary evidence; temporary requires temporal or multi-view support.

labels.spatial_context: Front and front-side views of route-local lane boundaries.
labels.hysteresis: Temporary and missing states require two supporting intervals; occlusion may change at source timestamps.

labels.description: Visible or mapped road-surface material.

allowed_values.description: Bituminous asphalt road surface.
Concrete slab road surface.
Road surface made from paving stones or blocks.
Compacted or loose gravel road surface.
Natural-earth or otherwise unpaved road surface.

acquisition.required_evidence: An explicit map surface attribute or a sufficiently visible drivable surface.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use fresh explicit map material and visual appearance, preferring map unless temporary surface coverage is supported.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No map attribute and no visible road is unavailable or not_observable. Unresolved map/visual disagreement is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Ego lane and immediate drivable surface.
labels.hysteresis: Require persistent visual evidence before overriding mapped material.

labels.description: Visible state of the road surface.

allowed_values.description: Sufficient visible road area appears dry.
Road surface has visible wetness or water sheen.
Visible pooled or standing water occupies the road surface.
Snow visibly covers part of the driven surface.
Mud, debris, leaves, or another visible material contaminates the surface.

acquisition.required_evidence: Visible road surface plus precipitation, reflection, and observability cues.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify surface appearance with ORV and use IQC/FUS for reflection and temporal consistency.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Occluded or saturated road is not_observable. Dry requires sufficient visible area; uncertain wetness versus reflection is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Visible ego lane ahead.
labels.hysteresis: Wet and snow states require persistence; standing water may enter immediately with strong evidence.

labels.description: Road-edge treatments visible or mapped in the local corridor.

allowed_values.description: Raised curb borders the road edge.
Metal or equivalent guardrail borders the road.
Permanent solid barrier borders the road.
Temporary barrier borders or constrains the road edge.
Paved shoulder exists beside the travel lanes.
Unpaved shoulder exists beside the travel lanes.
Grass directly borders the road edge.
No listed edge treatment exists in the completely observed road-edge ROI.

acquisition.required_evidence: Map edge, barrier, or shoulder primitives and visible road edges.
acquisition.routing_policy: Extract mapped primitives, detect visible edge treatments, and form a subject-aligned union.
acquisition.fallback_policy: An edge outside coverage is not negative. None requires complete observation; temporary and permanent barriers remain distinct evidence.

labels.spatial_context: Both road edges in the local route ROI.
labels.hysteresis: Visual-only edge types require persistence unless geometry is explicit.
labels.none_semantics: Both relevant road edges were observed and no listed treatment is present.

labels.description: Special road structures on the current route.

allowed_values.description: The route traverses a bridge structure.
The route traverses an enclosed tunnel.
The route crosses a railway at grade.
A designated pedestrian crossing is present.
A gate or controlled access barrier is present.
No listed structure exists in the completely observed route corridor.

acquisition.required_evidence: Explicit map structure tags or observable structure appearance.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use mapped structures and visual corroboration for tunnels, crossings, and gates.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR cannot infer untagged structures from flat geometry. Missing map and non-visible structure is not_observable; conflicts are ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Current road and 100 m selected-route lookahead.
labels.hysteresis: Mapped structures remain active while ego is inside the structure extent.
labels.none_semantics: The route corridor was completely observed and no listed structure is present.

labels.description: Temporary road-work conditions.

allowed_values.description: Active or clearly marked roadwork activity is present.
One or more normal travel lanes are closed.
Temporary routing directs traffic away from the normal route.
Traffic cones define or modify the road space.
Temporary physical barriers modify the road space.
Temporary signs govern or inform current traffic.
No listed workzone condition is present in the observed road area.

acquisition.required_evidence: Temporal road imagery and optional fresh roadwork or route-deviation data.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect temporary road elements with ORV and combine fresh mapped roadworks and route deviation in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A single isolated cone is low confidence; stale map-only roadworks cannot establish visual subtypes. Insufficient road visibility is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Multi-view road and route corridor.
labels.hysteresis: Require repeated support for entry and a longer clear interval for exit.
labels.none_semantics: The road and control area were sufficiently observed with no workzone condition.

labels.description: Traffic controls present in the route-local scene.

allowed_values.description: A traffic signal is present.
A stop sign is present.
A yield sign is present.
A speed-limit sign is present.
A temporary traffic sign is present.
A person is actively directing traffic.
No listed control is present in the completely observed control area.

acquisition.required_evidence: Mapped regulatory elements or visible traffic controls.
acquisition.routing_policy: List map-local controls, detect visible controls, associate subjects, and union current controls.
acquisition.fallback_policy: None requires complete map or visible coverage. A visible but unassociated control is scene-present but not junction-applicable.

labels.spatial_context: Current road and next route-relevant junction.
labels.hysteresis: Static mapped controls persist by geometry; visual-only controls require repeated support.
labels.none_semantics: The relevant control area was completely observed and no listed control is present.

labels.description: State of the route-relevant traffic signal.

allowed_values.description: The applicable signal displays red.
The applicable signal displays red and yellow together.
The applicable signal displays yellow.
The applicable signal displays green.
The applicable signal is flashing.
The applicable signal is present but unlit.
Complete association evidence shows no signal applies to the current movement.

acquisition.required_evidence: Route-relevant signal association and several visual frames showing signal state.
acquisition.routing_policy: Identify candidate mapped signals, read temporal visual state, and resolve the controlling subject in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Occluded or out-of-FOV signal is not_observable; multiple plausible signals are ambiguous. Not applicable requires complete association.

labels.spatial_context: Signal-specific route movement.
labels.hysteresis: State changes must persist for the configured minimum frame count except validated flashing.
labels.none_semantics: No applicable traffic signal exists for the current movement after complete association.

labels.description: Solar or visually inferred phase of day.

allowed_values.description: Solar elevation and illumination correspond to daytime.
The scene lies in the configured pre-sunrise twilight interval.
The scene lies in the configured post-sunset twilight interval.
Solar elevation and illumination correspond to nighttime.

acquisition.required_evidence: Absolute timestamp and location, or observable sky and illumination.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute astronomical solar elevation when time and location are valid; otherwise use ORV visual evidence.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No valid absolute time and no observable lighting is not_observable. Dawn and dusk use frozen solar-angle boundaries.

labels.spatial_context: Whole scene.
labels.hysteresis: Use solar-angle boundary margins to avoid phase oscillation.

labels.description: Visible sky condition.

allowed_values.description: Visible sky is predominantly free of cloud cover.
Visible sky contains a mixture of clouds and clear regions.
Visible sky is predominantly covered by cloud.

acquisition.required_evidence: Sufficient visible sky pixels across usable cameras.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify sky condition across sky-visible camera clips.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Too little sky, tunnel, or severe exposure is not_observable. Inconsistent views are solid-angle weighted or ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Sky-visible camera regions.
labels.hysteresis: Require sustained evidence before changing sky class.

labels.description: Precipitation visible in camera imagery.

allowed_values.description: No precipitation is visibly supported in sufficiently observable imagery.
Visible evidence supports liquid precipitation.
Visible evidence supports snow precipitation.
Visible evidence supports mixed rain and snow precipitation.

acquisition.required_evidence: Temporal imagery with visible precipitation, streak, spray, or road cues.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify precipitation with ORV and use IQC artifact evidence for corroboration.
acquisition.fallback_policy: None visible is not a meteorological no-rain claim. Insufficient visibility is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Forward and surround camera views.
labels.hysteresis: Require multiple frames for precipitation entry and a longer clear window for exit.
labels.none_semantics: Sufficient observable imagery contains no visible precipitation; this is not a meteorological absence claim.

labels.description: Atmospheric causes that reduce visibility.

allowed_values.description: Fog visibly reduces scene contrast and range.
Haze or atmospheric veiling visibly reduces contrast.
Active precipitation visibly degrades visibility.
Vehicle or road water spray visibly degrades the view.
Airborne smoke or dust visibly degrades the view.
No listed atmospheric degradation is present in a sufficient distant view.

acquisition.required_evidence: Distant-scene contrast, temporal imagery, and veiling or contrast measurements.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use ORV to identify semantic causes and IQC to measure contrast and veiling.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Lens contamination must remain separate. No distant view is not_observable; multiple supported causes may coexist.

labels.spatial_context: Forward and surround distant-scene regions.
labels.hysteresis: Require sustained degradation and a longer recovery interval before emitting none.
labels.none_semantics: Sufficient distant scene content was visible without a listed atmospheric degradation.

labels.description: Lighting available on the driven road.

allowed_values.description: Natural daylight illuminates the road.
Operating street lighting visibly illuminates the road.
The road is not materially illuminated by daylight or fixed road lighting.
Operating tunnel lighting illuminates the road.

acquisition.required_evidence: Visible illumination and road-light context, day phase, and optional mapped tunnel.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify visible road lighting and fuse day phase and mapped tunnel context.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Visible but unlit street lamps do not imply street_lit. Clipped or black imagery is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Road-facing camera views and current mapped road.
labels.hysteresis: Use longer dwell near tunnel and daylight transitions.

labels.description: Glare source and direction affecting the road view.

allowed_values.description: Sun glare affects forward road views.
Sun glare affects side road views.
Vehicle headlights create material glare.
Bright wet-road reflection creates material glare.
No supported glare source affects usable camera views.

acquisition.required_evidence: Saturated bright regions, directional bloom, temporal persistence, and semantic source.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect glare candidates with IQC, assign semantic cause with ORV, and validate persistence in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Exposure saturation alone is not glare. Unresolved cause is ambiguous; sufficient clean imagery can emit none.

labels.spatial_context: Per-camera road view, aggregated to scene.
labels.hysteresis: Require persistence across multiple frames and a clear interval before exit.
labels.none_semantics: Usable camera views contain no supported glare condition.

labels.description: Density and flow state of motorized traffic.

allowed_values.description: No motorized traffic is present in a sufficiently observable road ROI.
Motorized traffic occupancy is within the frozen low-density bin.
Motorized traffic occupancy is within the frozen medium-density bin.
Motorized traffic occupancy is within the frozen high-density bin.
Dense traffic repeatedly alternates between stopping and moving.

acquisition.required_evidence: Track counts and occupancy in an observable ROI, or sufficient multi-view traffic imagery.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute normalized traffic occupancy from tracks and use ORV only as an experimental fallback.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Front-only coverage cannot certify empty. Missing tracks plus low visual coverage is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Ego-local road ROI with observable-area normalization.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate bin entry and exit thresholds; stop-and-go requires repeated motion cycles.
labels.none_semantics: The sufficiently observed road ROI contains no motorized traffic.

labels.description: Density of vulnerable road users.

allowed_values.description: No vulnerable road user is present in sufficiently observed relevant areas.
VRU density is within the frozen low bin.
VRU density is within the frozen medium bin.
VRU density is within the frozen high bin.

acquisition.required_evidence: VRU tracks or sufficient imagery of sidewalks, crossings, and road ROI.
acquisition.routing_policy: Count stable VRUs by observable ROI and dwell; apply audited density bins.
acquisition.fallback_policy: None requires sufficient relevant-area coverage. Class disagreement is ambiguous; occluded sidewalks are not negative.

labels.spatial_context: Sidewalk, crossing, and road VRU ROI.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate bin entry and exit thresholds.
labels.none_semantics: Sufficient relevant-area coverage contains no vulnerable road user.

labels.description: Density of parked vehicles along the corridor.

allowed_values.description: No parked vehicle is present in a sufficiently observable parking-edge ROI.
Parked-vehicle density is within the frozen low bin.
Parked-vehicle density is within the frozen medium bin.
Parked-vehicle density is within the frozen high bin.

acquisition.required_evidence: Vehicle motion history, parking or curb context, and observable imagery.
acquisition.routing_policy: Identify stationary non-traffic vehicles, add parked semantics, and apply calibrated density bins.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Stopped traffic must not be called parked. Short track history is ambiguous; no observable parking edge is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Curb and parking ROI along the local corridor.
labels.hysteresis: Require stable actor motion state before entering or leaving parked classification.
labels.none_semantics: A sufficiently observable curb or parking ROI contains no parked vehicle.

labels.description: Presence of traffic moving in the opposing direction.

allowed_values.description: No oncoming actor is present in a sufficiently observable oncoming ROI.
At least one actor is moving in an opposing connected traffic stream.

acquisition.required_evidence: Actor relative heading and connected oncoming-lane association, or sufficient temporal imagery.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect opposing motion in connected lanes and validate direction across sources.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Absent requires sufficient coverage. Missing map direction and uncertain visual heading is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Forward and side oncoming-traffic ROI.
labels.hysteresis: Present enters on one stable actor track and exits only after the ROI is clear for the configured dwell.
labels.none_semantics: A sufficiently observable oncoming-traffic ROI contains no oncoming actor.

labels.description: Road-agent classes present in the observable scene.

allowed_values.description: Passenger car or similar light personal vehicle.
Van or other light commercial vehicle.
Heavy goods vehicle or articulated truck.
Bus or coach.
Powered two-wheeled motor vehicle.
Pedal bicycle and rider.
Standing electric scooter and rider.
Person traveling on foot.
Person using a wheelchair or mobility chair.
Animal present in the road-scene ROI.
Marked or active emergency-response vehicle.
Vehicle primarily used for construction work.
No listed road agent is present in sufficiently observed road and sidewalk regions.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable track classes and actor-visible images.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use tracks for stable actor identity, ORV for difficult classes, and union interval actors in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: None requires sufficient road and sidewalk coverage. Unsupported fine class remains ambiguous rather than guessed.

labels.spatial_context: All observable road and sidewalk camera regions.
labels.hysteresis: Retain an actor class across short detection gaps using stable identity only.
labels.none_semantics: Road and sidewalk regions were sufficiently observed and no listed agent is present.

labels.description: Gap-aware ego-speed category with raw ego_speed_kph retained.

allowed_values.description: Speed is within the frozen physical-zero epsilon.
Speed is above stationary and below 5 km/h.
Speed is at least 5 and below 30 km/h.
Speed is at least 30 and at most 60 km/h.
Speed is above 60 km/h.

acquisition.required_evidence: Metric pose timestamps or normalized wheel speed.
acquisition.routing_policy: Derive gap-aware speed and apply frozen epsilon, dwell, and speed-bin boundaries.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Missing or poor pose and CAN is unavailable. Source disagreement above tolerance is ambiguous; raw ego_speed_kph is retained.

labels.spatial_context: Ego vehicle.
labels.hysteresis: Use boundary-specific entry and exit margins and minimum dwell.

labels.description: Observed ego motion state.

allowed_values.description: Ego speed remains within the stopped threshold.
Ego transitions from stopped into forward motion.
Ego moves without another more specific motion state.
Ego moves forward below the creeping threshold.
Ego has sustained positive longitudinal acceleration.
Ego has sustained negative longitudinal acceleration.
Ego moves in reverse according to signed motion or gear evidence.

acquisition.required_evidence: Signed speed, acceleration, timestamps, and optional gear.
acquisition.routing_policy: Apply the frozen priority state machine: stopped, reversing, starting, creeping, accelerating/decelerating, moving.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No reliable motion source is unavailable; threshold oscillation is coalesced instead of emitted as rapid events.

labels.spatial_context: Ego vehicle.
labels.hysteresis: Use state-specific entry, exit, and dwell thresholds.

labels.description: Maneuver executed by the actual ego trajectory, independent of the planned route action.

allowed_values.description: Actual trajectory follows the current lane without another maneuver.
Actual trajectory completes a left turn.
Actual trajectory completes a right turn.
Actual trajectory reverses road direction through a U-turn.
Actual trajectory changes to an adjacent left lane.
Actual trajectory changes to an adjacent right lane.
Actual trajectory joins another traffic stream.
Actual trajectory leaves a traffic stream onto a branch.
Actual trajectory moves to and stops or settles at the road edge.
Actual trajectory leaves a stopped edge or parking position into traffic.
Actual trajectory passes a slower road user and advances ahead.
Actual trajectory completes a meaningful stopping maneuver.

acquisition.required_evidence: Actual ego trajectory, lane or road topology, and map-matched transitions.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify complete executed maneuvers from heading change, lane crossing, and road topology.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Planned route alone is prohibited. Invalid trajectory is unavailable; competing lane and turn interpretations are ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Approach, active maneuver, and exit trajectory.
labels.hysteresis: Maneuver boundaries require sustained geometric state and cannot overlap incompatibly.

labels.description: Strong ego response derived from motion signals.

allowed_values.description: No configured strong ego response occurs in a sufficiently observed interval.
Sustained longitudinal deceleration exceeds the frozen hard-brake threshold.
A severe response rapidly brings the vehicle to a stop.
Steering or curvature response exceeds road-relative evasive thresholds.

acquisition.required_evidence: Acceleration, speed, yaw or steering response, and road-relative curvature.
acquisition.routing_policy: Apply sustained deceleration and curvature-relative thresholds to synchronized motion evidence.
acquisition.fallback_policy: ORV cannot originate this label. No quality motion signal is unavailable; planned sharp turns are not evasive steering.

labels.spatial_context: Ego motion interval.
labels.hysteresis: Use stronger entry than exit thresholds and a refractory interval.
labels.none_semantics: Reliable motion evidence shows no configured strong response.

labels.description: Temporal interaction with another vehicle.

allowed_values.description: Another vehicle enters ego's path or lane ahead.
A lead or nearby vehicle leaves ego's path or lane.
A lead vehicle materially decelerates while interacting with ego.
Another vehicle merges into the traffic stream ahead.
Another vehicle crosses the ego path.
Oncoming traffic encroaches into ego's expected path space.
A parked vehicle enters traffic near ego.
A vehicle door opens into or near ego's travel space.
Another vehicle visibly yields to ego or another relevant movement.
Another vehicle fails to yield where the interaction requires it.
Another vehicle passes ego and advances ahead.
No listed vehicle interaction occurs in the observable interval.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable vehicle identity, relative trajectory, and temporal camera evidence.
acquisition.routing_policy: Propose geometric interactions from tracks, classify semantic interaction over temporal clips, and require actor continuity.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A single image is invalid. No stable actor or temporal observability is not_observable; source disagreement is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Actor-relative pre-event, active, and post-event interval.
labels.hysteresis: Require actor continuity and complete event boundaries before resolution.
labels.none_semantics: The interval was sufficiently observable and no listed vehicle interaction occurred.

labels.description: Temporal interaction with a vulnerable road user.

allowed_values.description: A pedestrian crosses the ego path or roadway.
A pedestrian transitions from roadside space into the road.
A pedestrian waits at a crossing opportunity.
A pedestrian travels longitudinally along or beside the road.
A cyclist crosses the ego path or roadway.
A cyclist merges into ego's traffic stream or path.
A VRU enters the conflict region with limited warning.
A previously occluded VRU emerges into relevant view or path.
A VRU visibly yields during the interaction.
A VRU does not yield during a relevant priority interaction.
No listed VRU interaction occurs in the observable interval.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable VRU identity, path relation, and temporal camera clip.
acquisition.routing_policy: Propose geometric interactions from tracks, resolve temporal semantics with ORV, and validate ego-path relation.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A single image cannot establish entering, emergence, or yielding. Occluded actor without temporal evidence is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: VRU-relative pre-event, active, and post-event interval.
labels.hysteresis: Require actor continuity and complete event boundaries before resolution.
labels.none_semantics: The interval was sufficiently observable and no listed VRU interaction occurred.

labels.description: Actual ego response to an applicable traffic control.

allowed_values.description: Ego stops in response to an applicable red signal.
Ego proceeds in response to an applicable green signal.
Ego stops in response to an applicable stop sign.
Ego yields in response to an applicable yield sign.
Ego stops for a crosswalk or crossing user.
Ego stops at an applicable railway crossing.
Ego follows directions from a traffic officer.
Complete evidence shows no control response is required.

acquisition.required_evidence: Applicable control association, current control state, and actual ego trajectory.
acquisition.routing_policy: Identify the control, read its visual state, derive ego response, and match them temporally in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A missing component is unavailable or not_observable. Unrelated visible controls must not be associated.

labels.spatial_context: Applicable control and ego stop or movement corridor.
labels.hysteresis: Control identity remains fixed through the response event.
labels.none_semantics: Complete control association shows no ego response is required.

labels.description: Right-of-way state during an interaction.

allowed_values.description: Applicable rules and current state give ego priority.
Applicable rules and current state give another participant priority.
Sufficient evidence shows genuinely negotiated or unclear priority.
No interaction or control context requires a priority assignment.

acquisition.required_evidence: Static priority rules, route movement, actor movement, and current control state.
acquisition.routing_policy: Resolve static rules, optionally disambiguate valid topology with BMR, and determine current priority in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: BMR receives no camera data. Ambiguous_priority is a valid negotiated state only with sufficient evidence; missing evidence uses status ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Participants and controls in the priority conflict area.
labels.hysteresis: Retain priority state through one interaction unless control state changes.
labels.none_semantics: No interaction or traffic-control context requires a priority assignment.

labels.description: Observed roadway hazard.

allowed_values.description: A non-debris obstacle occupies relevant road space.
Loose debris occupies relevant road space.
The planned or current lane is materially blocked.
A vehicle travels against the permitted direction.
An active emergency vehicle approaches or requires response.
Corroborated evidence shows physical collision or contact.
No listed hazard occurs in the observable route corridor.

acquisition.required_evidence: Temporal route imagery, tracks or LiDAR, and route-path occupancy.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect path occupancy and wrong-way motion geometrically, identify semantic hazards with ORV, and corroborate in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Collision requires contact or multiple-source evidence, never one VLM frame. An unobservable path is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Current and selected-route path corridor.
labels.hysteresis: Retain a hazard until its path occupancy or effect is clearly resolved.
labels.none_semantics: The route corridor was sufficiently observable and no listed hazard occurred.

labels.description: Ego response caused by a valid hazard.

allowed_values.description: A valid hazard occurs without a supported ego response.
Ego reduces speed in response to the hazard.
Ego stops in response to the hazard.
Ego changes path locally to avoid the hazard.
Ego changes lanes to avoid the hazard.
Ego yields in response to the hazard.

acquisition.required_evidence: A valid hazard event and actual ego trajectory after hazard onset.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify speed and lateral response after a validated hazard and assess causal timing.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No valid hazard cannot produce a response. Causality uncertain because of an unrelated maneuver is ambiguous.

labels.spatial_context: Ego trajectory relative to the hazard.
labels.hysteresis: Response begins only after hazard onset and ends after stable recovery.
labels.none_semantics: A valid hazard is present but no listed ego response is supported.

labels.description: Transitions in traffic-flow state.

allowed_values.description: Ego enters sustained congested traffic.
Ego leaves sustained congested traffic.
Ego joins a traffic queue.
Ego leaves a traffic queue.
Traffic repeatedly alternates between stopping and moving.
Ego encounters a road closure affecting the route.
Ego enters a workzone interval.
Ego leaves a workzone interval.
No listed traffic-flow transition occurs in the observable interval.

acquisition.required_evidence: Ego speed history, traffic occupancy, and road or workzone context.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect queue and congestion transitions from motion and traffic, identify closure semantics, and segment entry or exit.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A stop at a signal is not congestion without traffic evidence. A scene ending before transition resolution remains interrupted context.

labels.spatial_context: Ego-local traffic stream and route context.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate sustained entry and exit dwell for queue and congestion states.
labels.none_semantics: The interval was sufficiently observable and no listed traffic-flow transition occurred.

labels.description: Actor classes participating in an event.

allowed_values.description: A general motor vehicle participates in the event.
A pedestrian participates in the event.
A cyclist participates in the event.
A motorcycle participates in the event.
An emergency vehicle participates in the event.
An animal participates in the event.
A static obstacle participates in the event.
A valid event has no participating actor from the listed classes.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable actor identities and classes linked to a valid event.
acquisition.routing_policy: Resolve actor classes and attach only event participants.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Scene-present but uninvolved actors are excluded. A visible unknown class is ambiguous, not none.

labels.spatial_context: Actors causally participating in the parent event.
labels.hysteresis: Actor participation is fixed when the parent event is finalized.
labels.none_semantics: A valid event was observed without a listed participating actor.

labels.description: Observed resolution of an event.

allowed_values.description: The event completes without unresolved hazard or collision.
Observation ends or is interrupted before outcome resolution.
The event resolves with the hazard successfully avoided.
The event remains active or its outcome cannot be resolved.
Corroborated evidence shows the event ends in collision.

acquisition.required_evidence: Complete event interval, participant or hazard state, ego motion, and collision evidence when applicable.
acquisition.routing_policy: Apply the frozen outcome state machine after all event evidence is resolved.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Scene end produces interrupted or unresolved. Normal completion requires observable resolution; collision requires corroboration.

labels.spatial_context: Complete parent event.
labels.hysteresis: Outcome is assigned once when the event closes and is not smoothed across events.

labels.description: Phase subinterval inside an event instance.

allowed_values.description: Initial transition into the event.
Main active interval of the event.
Transition from active event toward completion.

acquisition.required_evidence: Final parent-event boundaries and confidence.
acquisition.routing_policy: Assign ordered onset, active, and resolution subintervals with the temporal segmenter.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No independent model call is allowed. Missing resolution leaves an active unresolved event; phases cannot overlap or exceed bounds.

labels.spatial_context: Within one EventInstance.
labels.hysteresis: Phase boundaries are finalized once with the parent event.

labels.description: Source of scene or actor occlusion.

allowed_values.description: A static object causes occlusion.
A moving or dynamic actor causes occlusion.
The ego vehicle body or mounted equipment causes occlusion.
Weather or atmospheric effects cause occlusion.
No supported occlusion source affects the observable subject.

acquisition.required_evidence: Target or scene visibility over time and candidate occluders.
acquisition.routing_policy: Propose geometric occluders, classify semantic source, and union supported causes.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No target visibility reference is not_observable. None requires clear line of sight.

labels.spatial_context: Actor-camera or camera-scene line of sight.
labels.hysteresis: Retain source across short track gaps only when geometry remains valid.
labels.none_semantics: The target or scene was sufficiently observable with no supported occlusion source.

labels.description: Severity of scene or actor occlusion.

allowed_values.description: The subject has no material occlusion.
A minority of the subject or scene is occluded.
A majority or task-critical portion is occluded.
The known subject is fully occluded from the camera.

acquisition.required_evidence: Visible fraction or temporally inferred extent of a known actor or scene region.
acquisition.routing_policy: Measure geometric overlap where possible, estimate semantic level, and calibrate thresholds.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Full requires track continuity or known geometry; an actor never observed cannot be asserted fully occluded by ORV alone.

labels.spatial_context: Known subject in one camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate severity entry and exit thresholds.
labels.none_semantics: The subject is sufficiently observable and has no material occlusion.

labels.description: Visibility of a tracked or visual actor.

allowed_values.description: The actor is substantially fully visible.
A meaningful portion of the actor is occluded or truncated.
Only a small but supported portion of the actor is visible.
A known in-FOV actor is not currently visible because of occlusion.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable actor identity and per-camera visible extent.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute visible or truncated fractions and resolve semantic visibility.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No actor identity is unavailable. Outside FOV is represented by FOV state; occluded in-FOV actor may be not_visible.

labels.spatial_context: One identified actor in one camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Retain identity across bounded missed detections before changing to not_visible.

labels.description: Image scale of an actor.

allowed_values.description: Actor image size is within the class- and camera-normalized normal range.
Actor image size is below the normal range.
Actor image size is near the minimum reliable visual scale.

acquisition.required_evidence: Actor box or mask, image resolution, and actor class.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute pixel-height or area bins normalized by camera resolution and actor class.
acquisition.fallback_policy: ORV may label experimental visual actors. No valid actor geometry is unavailable.

labels.spatial_context: One identified actor in one camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate pixel-scale entry and exit boundaries.
labels.none_semantics: The actor has a normal image scale for its class and camera.

labels.description: Range category of an actor.

allowed_values.description: Actor metric range is within the frozen near bin.
Actor metric range is within the frozen middle bin.
Actor metric range is within the frozen far bin.
Actor metric range is beyond the far threshold but remains observable.

acquisition.required_evidence: LiDAR depth, 3D track, calibrated geometry, or a coarse monocular fallback.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use metric range and frozen bins; retain raw range meters when available.
acquisition.fallback_policy: VLM-only range is experimental with capped confidence. No metric or visual observability is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Ego-relative actor position.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate range-bin entry and exit boundaries.

labels.description: Actor position and motion relative to camera field of view.

allowed_values.description: Actor lies within the configured central FOV region.
Actor lies near an image or calibrated FOV boundary.
Actor extent is clipped by the image boundary.
Actor moves from outside or edge into the camera FOV.
Actor moves toward and out of the camera FOV.

acquisition.required_evidence: Camera calibration and temporal actor boxes or tracks.
acquisition.routing_policy: Evaluate center, edge, truncation, and entering or leaving trend deterministically.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A single frame cannot establish entering or leaving. Missing calibration is unavailable; missed detection is not automatically leaving.

labels.spatial_context: One actor relative to one calibrated camera FOV.
labels.hysteresis: Use inner and outer FOV margins and temporal direction consistency.

labels.description: Semantic and visual clutter of the observable scene.

allowed_values.description: Observable scene clutter is within the frozen low bin.
Observable scene clutter is within the frozen medium bin.
Observable scene clutter is within the frozen high bin.

acquisition.required_evidence: Observable imagery plus semantic-object and edge-density features.
acquisition.routing_policy: Combine semantic clutter, actor counts, and visual edge density using calibrated bins.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Severe blur or occlusion is not_observable. High traffic alone is not necessarily high clutter.

labels.spatial_context: Per-camera or surround-scene observable area.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate clutter-bin entry and exit thresholds.

labels.description: Overlap of an actor with nearer scene content.

allowed_values.description: No material nearer-object overlap affects the actor.
A moderate fraction of the actor overlaps nearer content.
A large or task-critical fraction overlaps nearer content.

acquisition.required_evidence: Actor boxes or masks, overlap geometry, and depth ordering.
acquisition.routing_policy: Compute overlap with nearer objects and apply calibrated severity bins.
acquisition.fallback_policy: 2D overlap without depth has lower confidence. Missing actor geometry is unavailable.

labels.spatial_context: One actor and nearer image content.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate overlap-fraction entry and exit boundaries.
labels.none_semantics: The actor is sufficiently observable and has no material nearer-object overlap.

labels.description: Contrast condition affecting perception.

allowed_values.description: Scene or target contrast is within the calibrated normal range.
Target or scene contrast is materially reduced.
Backlighting reduces a subject primarily to a silhouette.

acquisition.required_evidence: Pixel luminance or chroma plus target-background context.
acquisition.routing_policy: Measure local and global contrast, then distinguish semantic low contrast from silhouette.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Invalid exposure is handled first by exposure or frame status. Object contrast without an identified target is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Whole camera view or identified actor crop.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate calibrated contrast entry and exit thresholds.
labels.none_semantics: Contrast is within the calibrated normal range.

labels.description: Lighting conditions affecting camera perception.

allowed_values.description: No listed difficult lighting condition affects the usable view.
Strong illumination behind the subject or scene impairs visibility.
Important scene regions lie in materially deep shadow.
Bright and dark regions exceed normal camera dynamic-range demands.
Rapid lighting transition occurs at a tunnel entrance or exit.

acquisition.required_evidence: Exposure, HDR, shadow metrics, and temporal semantic imagery.
acquisition.routing_policy: Propose measurable lighting conditions, assign semantic condition, and enforce neutral-value exclusion.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Invalid frame is not_observable. Normal cannot coexist with an abnormal lighting value.

labels.spatial_context: One camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Require persistence for deep shadow and HDR; tunnel transition follows temporal change evidence.
labels.none_semantics: The usable camera view contains no listed difficult lighting condition.

labels.description: Glare affecting a camera view.

allowed_values.description: Sunlight creates material glare in the camera view.
Vehicle headlights create material glare in the camera view.
Wet-road reflection creates material glare in the camera view.
No supported glare source affects the usable camera view.

acquisition.required_evidence: Saturation and bloom metrics plus a semantic light source.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect directional glare regions and classify sun, headlight, or wet-road source.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Exposure clipping without directional bloom is not glare. Unresolved cause is ambiguous; a clean visible frame can emit none.

labels.spatial_context: One camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Require temporal persistence and a clear recovery interval.
labels.none_semantics: The usable camera view contains no supported glare source.

labels.description: Image exposure condition.

allowed_values.description: Exposure metrics are within the frozen usable range.
Bright clipping materially affects the image.
Dark clipping materially affects the image.
Material overexposed and underexposed regions coexist.

acquisition.required_evidence: Decoded pixel histogram and spatial luminance distribution.
acquisition.routing_policy: Classify bright clipping, dark clipping, and mixed regions with frozen metrics.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Decode failure is corrupted frame status; exposure is not_observable for invalid pixels.

labels.spatial_context: One camera frame.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate clipping entry and exit thresholds.
labels.none_semantics: Exposure metrics are within the frozen normal range.

labels.description: Image blur condition.

allowed_values.description: Adequately textured image content shows no material blur.
Temporal or directional evidence supports motion-induced blur.
Evidence supports optical defocus rather than scene motion.

acquisition.required_evidence: Spatial frequency, edge spread, temporal flow, and ego-motion cues.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect blur deterministically and distinguish motion versus defocus with temporal cues; ORV only adjudicates ambiguous cause.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A low-texture scene without enough edges is not_observable. None requires adequate texture.

labels.spatial_context: One camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate blur entry and exit metric thresholds.
labels.none_semantics: Adequately textured image content shows no material blur.

labels.description: Weather artifacts visible in an image.

allowed_values.description: Rain streaks are visible in the camera image.
Snow streaks or flakes are visible in the camera image.
Water spray visibly affects the image.
Atmospheric fog or haze visibly veils the image.
No listed weather artifact affects sufficiently observable image content.

acquisition.required_evidence: Temporal image pixels, streak or veiling patterns, and environment context.
acquisition.routing_policy: Propose measurable patterns, classify semantic artifact, and separate lens-fixed contamination.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No clean observable image region is not_observable. Atmospheric fog and lens condensation require temporal distinction.

labels.spatial_context: One camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Require repeated pattern support and a clear recovery interval.
labels.none_semantics: Sufficiently observable image content contains no listed weather artifact.

labels.description: Camera-fixed lens contamination.

allowed_values.description: Water droplets persist in image coordinates on the lens or cover.
Dirt contamination persists on the lens or cover.
Mud contamination persists on the lens or cover.
Condensation or fogging persists on the lens or cover.
No listed lens contamination persists on the observable camera.

acquisition.required_evidence: Image-coordinate persistence across scene motion and semantic contaminant appearance.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect fixed artifacts, classify contaminant type, and validate persistence.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A one-frame splash remains weather artifact until persistent. Insufficient baseline is ambiguous; a clean lens emits none.

labels.spatial_context: One camera view over scene motion.
labels.hysteresis: Require persistence for entry and a longer clean interval for exit.
labels.none_semantics: The lens was observable over time and no listed contamination is present.

labels.description: Decode, timing, and obstruction state of a camera frame.

allowed_values.description: The frame decodes, advances in time, and has no material obstruction.
A material portion of the camera view is obstructed.
Nearly all usable camera content is obstructed.
The decoded frame is effectively black.
Image content fails to advance despite evidence that it should change.
Timestamp or sequence evidence shows a missing expected frame.
The frame cannot be decoded or fails integrity checks.

acquisition.required_evidence: Decoder result, timestamps, frame hashes, neighboring cameras, and ego motion.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect normal, obstruction, black, frozen, dropped, and corrupted states deterministically; ORV only refines obstruction boundary.
acquisition.fallback_policy: A stationary scene alone cannot imply frozen. Semantic obstruction refinement cannot override decode or timing facts.

labels.spatial_context: One camera stream.
labels.hysteresis: Frozen and obstruction states require configured consecutive-frame evidence.
labels.none_semantics: The frame is valid, advancing, and materially unobstructed.

labels.description: Appearance conditions that make an actor difficult to recognize.

allowed_values.description: The actor has no listed unusual or deceptive appearance.
The actor or object has an uncommon form or category appearance.
The actor has an unusual articulation or pose.
The object is temporary or transient road-scene infrastructure.
Appearance supports multiple unresolved actor classes.
Appearance may plausibly be mistaken for another relevant class or state.

acquisition.required_evidence: Stable actor crop, scene context, and temporal identity.
acquisition.routing_policy: Use focused ORV classification with track identity and second-pass agreement for rare claims.
acquisition.fallback_policy: No stable actor or crop is unavailable. Normal cannot coexist with unusual values; rare claims require second-pass agreement.

labels.spatial_context: Identified actor crop with scene context.
labels.hysteresis: Retain appearance across short actor-track gaps; rare states need repeated support.
labels.none_semantics: The actor has no listed unusual or deceptive appearance.

labels.description: Visual condition of an expected mapped element.

allowed_values.description: The expected map element is clearly visible and consistent.
The expected element is present or expected but visually occluded.
The expected visible element is materially faded.
Temporary visual control or marking conflicts with the static map element.
A valid expected map element is absent from a sufficiently observable projected region.

acquisition.required_evidence: A projected expected map element and corresponding observable camera region.
acquisition.routing_policy: Identify the expected element, classify visual condition, and resolve map-visual conflict.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Projection or association failure is unavailable; outside FOV is not_observable. Visually missing requires a valid expected element.

labels.spatial_context: Projected map element in one camera view.
labels.hysteresis: Missing and faded require repeated observations unless the element is passed.

labels.description: Combined topology, actor, control, and visibility complexity.

allowed_values.description: Combined scene-complexity features fall in the frozen simple bin.
Combined scene-complexity features fall in the frozen moderate bin.
Combined scene-complexity features fall in the frozen complex bin.
Combined scene-complexity features fall in the frozen extreme bin.

acquisition.required_evidence: Multi-view scene, topology, actor counts, controls, and occlusion.
acquisition.routing_policy: Combine semantic assessment with normalized deterministic features and frozen human-audited calibration.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Complexity is not a raw VLM adjective. Missing major modalities lowers confidence; thresholds remain frozen from audit.

labels.spatial_context: Whole multi-view scene and route-local topology.
labels.hysteresis: Use separate calibrated class entry and exit thresholds.

labels.description: Co-presence of heterogeneous motorized and vulnerable traffic.

allowed_values.description: Sufficient observation does not show relevant heterogeneous co-presence.
Heterogeneous motorized and vulnerable participants coexist in the relevant ROI.

acquisition.required_evidence: Actor classes and shared road-space context over a common interval.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect heterogeneous participant co-presence in the same relevant ROI.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Different actors at unrelated times do not establish mixed traffic. Insufficient surround coverage is not_observable.

labels.spatial_context: Shared-lane and road participant ROI.
labels.hysteresis: Require temporal overlap and a clear interval before returning to absent.
labels.none_semantics: Sufficient observation shows no relevant heterogeneous participant co-presence.

labels.description: Visible temporary traffic-control elements.

allowed_values.description: No temporary traffic control is present in a sufficiently observed control area.
Temporary signs, cones, barriers, or officers modify traffic control.

acquisition.required_evidence: Visible temporary signs, cones, barriers, or officers plus expected static map state.
acquisition.routing_policy: Detect temporary controls visually, compare with static map state, and resolve presence in FUS.
acquisition.fallback_policy: Absent requires sufficient control-area visibility. Static mapped control alone is not temporary; conflict supports present only with visual evidence.

labels.spatial_context: Current road and junction control area.
labels.hysteresis: Require repeated visual support for entry and a longer clear interval for exit.
labels.none_semantics: The road and control area were sufficiently observed with no temporary traffic control.

excluded_labels.reason: Absolute rainfall rate is not reliable from imagery.
Requires dedicated measurement or a validated estimator.
Requires dedicated measurement or a validated estimator.
Requires metric scene geometry and a validated visibility estimator.
Absolute illuminance is not recoverable from auto-exposed imagery.
Cannot be confirmed reliably from current imagery.
Cannot be confirmed reliably from current imagery.
Requires comparison with an independent calibration reference.
Requires model output and ground truth.
Requires model output and ground truth.
Requires model output and ground truth.
Requires model output and ground truth.
Requires synchronized relative trajectories, distance, and TTC.
